summary: ~7 years across pension asset-liability management, LDI analysis, and funded-status analytics, spanning advisory work for Canadian defined benefit plans at Ortec Finance and delegated sign-off on multi-asset institutional portfolios ($5–25bn per engagement) at Moody's Analytics. Hands-on with stochastic scenario generation, actuarial liability modelling, stress testing, risk management, and analytics-platform implementation. CFA charterholder, dual MSc.

sections.heading: Pension ALM & Funded-Status Analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional client portfolios sized $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively ~$50bn across the book.
Oversee duration, key-rate, and parallel/non-parallel rate-shock analytics on multi-asset portfolios, translating outputs into funded-status sensitivity narratives for client investment teams.
Validate derivatives outputs (rates, FX, inflation) and review aggregation logic from security-level exposures to portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and risk management reporting.

sections.heading: Stress Testing & Cash-Flow Projection
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year), supporting cash management, refinancing, and asset-allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioral cash-flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays consistent with institutional liquidity expectations and contingency planning.

sections.heading: Governance, Reporting & Analytics-Platform Delivery
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework: independent review of curve construction, spread calibration, and economic defensibility prior to production release; serve as escalation point for client-critical issues with Heads of Risk and investment committees.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders and governance committees on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls, supporting data-governance standards.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; managed project timelines, dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders across client and product teams.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoped data and configuration requirements, validated model outputs post-deployment, and contributed to data-governance standards.
Successfully migrated all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform on plan.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, coordinating actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and project-management workstreams on milestone delivery.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes supporting executive and committee sign-off; developed go-to-market advisory collateral.

Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international defined benefit pension funds: analyzed funded status, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk management under base-case and stressed environments.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) — a three-plan jointly-sponsored merger — on a team of three, modelling Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

Conducted LDI analysis covering trade-offs across return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity for pension-fund clients; advised on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators; performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition and near-frontier robustness analysis.
Modelled pension actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types; performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk.
Presented ALM study findings at on-site client meetings, including investment-committee discussions at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
